zh-CN.title: WebApp 有了账户入口
items: 桌面图标统一使用 Sermo 品牌标识
启动时可以从本机已登录账户中选择
可为默认账户明确开启自动登录

en.title: A new WebApp account entry
items: The home-screen icon now consistently uses the Sermo brand
Choose from accounts already signed in on this device
Explicitly enable automatic sign-in for your default account
